customManagers.description: Track upstream macFUSE releases (tags are macfuse-<version>; pre-releases are not tracked).
The clang22 pin: a Mavergreen/clang-22 release tag.

The Drydock pin: a Mavergreen/drydock release tag (vX.Y.Z), as shipyard's fetch_drydock.sh reads it; build/adapt-helpers.sh rewrites upstream's closed mount_macfuse and load_macfuse with its drydock-macho-rewrite.

packageRules.description: An upstream macFUSE bump needs a person, so it never automerges. The kext's golden sha256 and its undefined-symbol and relocation counts (tests/retarget-kext-test.sh) and the strict guard's exact finding counts (tests/lib/objc-measure.tsv) were measured for the one upstream release tests/lib/goldens-upstream names. A new upstream fails them, saying 'refresh for upstream X.Y.Z', until a person checks the new kext and measurements and refreshes them.
prBodyNotes: **This bump needs a person.** The build fails at the strict compat guard and tests/retarget-kext-test.sh until the goldens are refreshed for the new upstream; each failure prints what it measured. Check the new kext: its undefined symbols are 10.9's five KPIs plus Recaulk's back-fill, and `_vnop_rename_desc` relocations replace every `_vnop_renamex_desc`. Then, on this branch, set `GOLDEN`, `GOLDEN_UNDEFINED` and `GOLDEN_RELOCS` in tests/retarget-kext-test.sh and each binary's rows in tests/lib/objc-measure.tsv to the printed values, write the new version to tests/lib/goldens-upstream, and commit. INGREDIENTS.md says the same.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/drydock/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, so a Linux build fails at the fetch until components/drydock/linux-sha256 names the new release's archive.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace components/drydock/linux-sha256 with the `drydock-<version without v>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <tag> -R Mavergreen/drydock -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/drydock/linux-sha256`. The bump must pass tests/helpers-recipe-test.sh, its strict guard measurement included.
